answers.question: Of the five, how many matched the dataset's label, and for how many of those does the quoted evidence support the verdict?
answers.answer: Out of the five, four out of five matched the dataset's label. Then, out of these three out of four had qouted evidence that supported the verdict.

answers.question: Is accuracy alone a good measure of this agent? Why or why not?
answers.answer: No I do not believe accuracy alone is a good measure of this agent because as I've just seen in the agent's traces, and qouted evidence, though an agent may match verdict to the dataset's label, it's reasoning may be off or the qouted evidence may not directly state a support to the claim, but the agent then takes it and concludes on the claim's verdict. So I think purely looking at the accuracy is not a good measure, and instead looking at the process of the agent's lookups and qouted evidence provides a better sense of how an agent is doing in terms of speed, accuracy, and method of proving/disproving a claim.
